A robot program failed to move "red_pen" (kind: pen) onto "green_case".
Program:
```python
obs = observe()
red_pen = obs["objects"]["red_pen"]
green_case = obs["zones"]["green_case"]

candidates = grasp_candidates("red_pen")
# Choose candidate with fingers aligned to the pen's long axis (yaw close to object_long_axis_yaw)
candidate = next(c for c in candidates if abs(c["yaw"] - red_pen["long_axis_yaw"]) < 0.1)

grasp(candidate)
if not observe()["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to grasp red_pen")

spots = free_spots("green_case", "red_pen")
spot = spots["spots"][0]
target_x, target_y = spot["x"], spot["y"]
target_yaw = spot["object_long_axis_yaw"]

# Adjust yaw to match the desired orientation of the pen (long axis aligned with zone)
# The gripper yaw at grasp is candidate["yaw"], and the pen's long axis is red_pen["long_axis_yaw"]
# We want the pen's long axis to be target_yaw, so we rotate by (target_yaw - red_pen["long_axis_yaw"])
delta = target_yaw - red_pen["long_axis_yaw"]
rotate_by(delta)

carry_to(target_x, target_y, height=0.18, yaw=target_yaw)
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("red_pen", "green_case")
```
